Hybrid classes are classes which can fill more than one of the core class roles: tank, healer, or damage dealer (DPS). Realistically, no character can tank, heal, and dps at the same time, but hybrids are frequently flexible enough to serve in one role or another (no matter what spec they have) if they have collected the gear required to serve that function. Hybrid classes are differentiated from pure classes. __TOC__

.]] Hydras are three-headed amphibious beasts native to both Azeroth and Outland. Historians have long disagreed about whether the immense hydras of Azeroth and Outland share a common ancestor. What is clear, however, is that these ruthless creatures have existed on both realms since ancient times. Each head appears to display a level of independent behavior. The forms of hydras vary somewhat between the two worlds.

Hyjal Summit is the setting of the Battle for Mount Hyjal instance. It is set four years before the beginning of World of Warcraft around the time of the Warcraft III campaign mission Twilight of the Gods, during in which the demon lord Archimonde leads the attack on Nordrassil while the defenders of Hyjal protect the World Tree. Even the units wear the same clothes they had in that mission. For instance, Horde shamans wear the same wolf-like fur on their heads. The Hyldnir is the main tribe of frost vrykul in Storm Peaks, living primarily in Brunnhildar Village, hence why they are also known as the Brunnhildar. Most, if not all, female members of the are warriors and train to compete in the Hyldsmeet, a competition in which warriors fight to determine who shall rule by Thorim's side. They are constantly warring with the Sons of Hodir in the name of the Thorim. They have a strict matriarchal society with the males, both Hyldnir and other races, as they think men are good for naught but slave labor, mostly in the nearby Forlorn Mine. Even females not of their faction are regarded with more respect than any man.

The Hyldsmeet is a competition where the Hyldnir compete to "rule by Thorim's side". While the Hyldnir think men are good for naught but slave labor, their disdain has one exception: Thorim. They run the Hyldsmeet to decide which of the Hyldnir should rule at his side. A vrykul lady can't even enter the competition if she hasn’t won at least one duel to the death. At the center of Brunnhildar Village is the Pit of the Fang, where they battle each other while riding on polar bears. The Hyldnir of Brunnhildar Village take part in the Hyldsmeet, while the Hyldnir of Valkyrion insulted it. Gretta the Arbiter seems to be the judge.

The "Hybrid Tax" is a term used to describe the baked-in reduction of the DPS of classes that can fulfill multiple roles. There is not necessarily a limiting factor that is visible in-game, nor is it a drastic reduction, and may be partially overcome with high skill. However, in general a class that can fulfill multiple roles will naturally have a lower DPS than "pure" DPS classes (Hunter, Warlock, Mage, Rogue). This hybrid tax is merely in place to maintain the popularity of pure DPS classes, since there would be a drop in their popularity if hybrid classes could produce the same DPS while having the advantage of taking on other roles as well. Again, it is not a steadfast rule or reduction

The vocals, performed by Bill Roper, mostly consist of remixed sound bites from Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. It is a parody of the song "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iGuuOdD6iY4 Mechanical Man]" from the RTS game .

Hyena Tenders are gnolls located at the Fetid Encampment in Thaldraszus. They are keeping watch over the Scavenging Cubs. Some are mounted on Scavenger Matriarchs and others are seen occasionally shooting down Falcons.
Hydro Life Seed is looted from Overripe Lifebinder's Gift found at Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. Upon pickup, this item immedeately grants 5 Dragon Isles Supplies.
Hydraulic Eroders are water elementals located at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.

I'm Playing All Sides is an exploration achievement earned by turning in Restored Obsidian Key to each of these individuals in and around the Obsidian Citadel. Note that the first key each week must be turned in to either Sabellian or Wrathion, depending on who you chose to side with. Only after making that first turn-in can you deliver a key to Bazentus or Igys.
__NOTOC__ Hypoxicron is a proto-dragon located at the Nelthazan Ruins in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
__NOTOC__ Hydro Pugilists are draenei and tauren located in Ancient Bough in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
__NOTOC__ Hyenamaster Durgun is a gnoll located in the Azure Span.
__NOTOC__ Hyena Matriarchs are hyenas located in the Azure Span.

I'll Make My Own Shadowflame is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Shadowflame Amalgamation after using Umbral Detonation, Fiery Meteor and Blistering Twilight on a Forgotten Specimen Tank to create and extinguish a Shadowflame Remnant in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible on Normal difficulty or higher.
Hydratooth Girdle drops from Magmorax in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Hyjal Hotfoot Challenge: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Kalimdor Hyjal Hotfoot Challenge.
Hyjal Hotfoot Challenge: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Kalimdor Hyjal Hotfoot Challenge.
Hyjal Hotfoot Challenge: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Hyjal Hotfoot Challenge.
Hyjal Hotfoot Reverse Challenge: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Kalimdor Hyjal Hotfoot Reverse Challenge.
Hyjal Hotfoot Reverse Challenge: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Kalimdor Hyjal Hotfoot Reverse Challenge.
Hyjal Hotfoot Reverse Challenge: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Hyjal Hotfoot Reverse Challenge.
Hydroforged Shell Helm drops from Slurpo, the Incredible Snail in the Waking Shores.
I Dream of Seeds is an exploration achievement earned by contributing a seed at each Emerald Bounty locations to help grow a series of plants.

IRC is an acronym for "Internet Relay Chat". WoW has been described as an RPG wrapped around an IRC client because so many of its slash commands and chat concepts are lifted from IRC (including, some would say, the atmosphere). The syntax for emotes, joining and parting a channel, and ignore are all familiar to IRC users. For more information about IRC, go to [http://www.irchelp.org irchelp.org].

Ice Armor is a mage spell that grants a self buff which increases armor and frost resistance, and has a chance to snare attackers. Enemies that attack with melee have a chance to become chilled, slowing their movement and attack speed. This is an improved version of Frost Armor.
Ice Barrier is a mage class talent. It is only available to Frost mages, and is automatically learned. Arcane mages receive Prismatic Barrier instead, and Fire mages receive Blazing Barrier.

Ian Strom is a level 47 rogue trainer located inside the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. To find him you must enter the tavern and make a left and ascend the stairs, then make another left turn to cross the rope gangway. As you enter the hull of the boat that is ahead of you, he will be in the room to your left.
__NOTOC__ Icecap is a Herb found in Winterspring. It can be gathered with Herbalism (290).

Ice trolls (also known as frost trolls) are trolls who can be found in frigid lands to which they have adapted. The most prominent tribe was the Drakkari, who once spanned the Drakkari Empire within Northrend; though the tribe and the empire has since fallen.
__NOTOC__ Ice Claw Bears are bear mobs found in the Tundrid Hills in Dun Morogh.
There were four Icecrown Obelisks surrounding the pinnacle of Icecrown Glacier — which contained the Lich King trapped in the Frozen Throne.
The Ice Protector was an enchanted keeper of the grove who Tyrande killed because it was guarding the Horn of Cenarius. She needed the Horn of Cenarius to wake Furion.
The Ice Deflector is a temporary shield from frost damage. It can be used from inventory and does not have to take up an equipment slot like a trinket. The Deflector can be used by non-engineers.

Ice Threaded Arrow is ammo for bows and crossbows. Special feature of this ammo is a bright blue glow (note: this glow even applies to arrows during Aimed Shot aiming, but on bows only; not on crossbows).
__NOTOC__ Ice Cold Milk: * Can be looted from most level 10-23 Humanoid monsters. * Can be looted from Barrel of Milk. * Can be purchased for from various drink vendors.
__NOTOC__ Iblis, Blade of the Fallen Seraph is a fast one-handed sword with a blue glow, similar to that of the weapon damage enchant.
Ice Guard is attached to head and leg armor to enchant the item with frost resistance.

__NOTOC__ Icebane Leggings are a quest reward from the quest The Only Song I Know... within the Naxxramas raid from Classic. will craft them for the player if they can supply him with 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Blue Sapphires, and 2 Essence of Waters.

An item collection, this was not a true set. There are no bonuses if you wear more than one or all of this set. This Collection was primarily for players who raided the frost damage-oriented Naxxramas. When Naxxramas was upgraded for Wrath of the Lich King with the release of patch 3.0.2, the items in this set became unavailable. The items in this set which were mob drops have been replaced by upgraded items, and the recipes can no longer be created due to the removal of required items such as Frozen Runes.

The Ice Thistle Hills is a large area just southeast of Everlook. It is the home of the Ice Thistle yeti, who live in and around a cave some way up in the hill, and in the surrounding area. Adventurers often come here to find Thick Yeti Furs and Pristine Yeti Horns for their quests. This area is a popular place to farm leather, as the yeti also drop money and "humanoid" drops (excepting cloth) such as poor quality armor. One can also find Icecaps around the outdoor area, Thorium veins inside the cave, and, if one is very lucky, a Black Lotus at the lip of the cave.

.]] Ice Lance is a Frost mage talent. It deals light damage to a target, and its damage is tripled against frozen targets. When cast, Ice Lance also causes all stored Icicles from Mastery: Icicles to begin launching at the target. Taking Glacial Spike removes this effect.

.]] An ice elemental is a type of frozen water elemental. The ice elementals surrounding the Frozen Glade were once companions to the local frost nymphs, but a volatile and destructive force swept through the land and turned them against the nymphs.
Ice Thistle E'ko is required for the quest Ice Thistle E'ko (quest). You can turn in three of these for one Juju Escape.

Iceblood Graveyard is the Frostwolf Clan's northernmost graveyard in Alterac Valley. It is one of the first two / three Horde targets for the Alliance when the battle starts due to the fact that it quickly allows Horde players to defend Iceblood Garrison and Iceblood Tower or for the Horde to attack the Alliance bases (Stonehearth Outpost and Stonehearth Bunker particularly). Like all Horde owned graveyards, it is protected by 4 Frostwolf Guardians at the start of the battle. It takes 4 minutes for the graveyard to finish switching control once the flag is captured. Guards are replaced when the graveyard switches control or after a length of time. The spawning point itself is just northeast

Iceblood Garrison is the Frostwolf Clan structure that is closest to Field of Strife. The Frostwolf Captain Galvangar resides in this barracks. The Garrison gate is guarded by Lieutenant Lewis and Lieutenant Vol'talar. Due to the difficulty of capturing Iceblood Graveyard directly, Iceblood Garrison is often the first horde outpost to be assaulted by alliance.
__NOTOC__ Iceguard Breastplate is an plate chestpiece which is crafted with Blacksmithing (375); taught by Plans: Iceguard Breastplate, a Violet Eye reputation reward.
__NOTOC__ Iceguard Helm is crafted with Blacksmithing (375); taught by Plans: Iceguard Helm.

__NOTOC__ Icefin Bluefish can be caught at many locations in Nagrand, as well as in the Eco-Dome Midrealm in Netherstorm. Exact values are hard to guess, but it may take an effective fishing skill of 425 or greater to reel these in. That is, your fishing skill, plus the effects of your Fishing Pole, Lure, and any gear you carry that adds to your fishing skill. Shares pool spawn locations with Pure Water and Figluster's Mudfish.

The Ice Thistle yetis are a group of Yeti living in Winterspring. The bulk of the population live in the Ice Thistle Hills, southeast of Everlook, and some Rogue Ice Thistle live in western Winterspring, on the borders of the road leading to Timbermaw Hold. Their fur is thick, and the longest horns are found on matriarchs and patriarchs.
Ice revenants are elemental revenants based around the element of ice.
Icepane Warhammer drops from Hammerspine in Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine in Dun Morogh.
Iceblade Hacker dropped from Ras Frostwhisper in Scholomance.
__NOTOC__ Ice Thistle Matriarchs can be found in the Ice Thistle Hills in Winterspring.

.]] Icecrown River is a freezing, often frozen river that cut across Icecrown Glacier from the upper corner to Lake Wintergrasp below, northwest to southeast. Much of the river is frozen over as well, at least on the surface. It is too wide to leap across and too fast and cold to swim, plus the banks drop sharply to the water, all along its length. They were too high, steep and slick, for anyone caught in the water to climb back out. It had no official name so Brann Bronzebeard named it Icecrown River.
__NOTOC__ Ice Caller Briatha is a frost mage dwarf of the Twilight's Hammer. She has a conversation with the and is part of the Midsummer Fire Festival.

The Ice Stone is a fixed device located in Ashenvale, Desolace, Stranglethorn Vale, Searing Gorge, Silithus, Hellfire Peninsula, and Slave Pens, during the Midsummer Fire Festival. These ice stones radiate a bitter cold, chilling the air around it and the platform on which it sits. Deep within its facets, a blue light pulses, waiting (to be melted!)

The Ice Chest appears after Ahune is defeated in the Slave Pens, during the Midsummer Fire Festival. A new Ice Stone will only appear after everything in this chest is removed. Even if there is no loot inside, all party members may need to open the chest once.
Icehollow Behemoths are yetis found at Frostblade Peak in the Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ Icehsard Elementals are ice elementals found in northern Howling Fjord.
Icemist Warriors are taunka, located in Icemist Village. These once brave defenders have died defending their village.
Ice Heart Jormungar Feeders are jormungar located in the Crystal Vice in the Dragonblight.
Ice Heart Jormungar Spawn are jormungar located in the Ice Heart Cavern in Dragonblight.
__NOTOC__ Icestorm is a frost wyrm located at the 7th Legion Front in the Dragonblight.
Ice Heart Cavern is located at the north end of the Crystal Vice in the Dragonblight. It is full of jormungar and dead crystalline Ice Giants. Rattlebore can be found in the back of the cavern.
